scope: Additive SWARM-004 development questions; no changes to the frozen32 query set.

questions.query: Can FRAMEWEAVER and MOSAIC revise their own native architecture through a bounded recursive grammar?
facts: Independent immutable proposals; own authored steel/masonry rules; finite shared zone and aggregate budgets; exact material ownership.

questions.query: Does a local cap satisfy an original required foreign socket, and is native Stone a solid bearing?
facts: Local termination never satisfies a foreign requirement; qualified joints require exact native material paths; Stone13 is powder and the explicit optional receiving variant uses LimestoneBlock38; no stability certificate.

questions.query: What proves SWARM-004 reciprocal Workbench Apply Undo Save and Windows reopen are complete?
facts: Native qualification and actual source-matched graphical Workbench Windows acceptance are separate; unresolved required obligations block Apply; two Draft/HOLD PRs with no automatic merge.

questions.query: Which SWARM-004 policy was frozen after recovery, and do two changed footprints prove reciprocal offer causality?
facts: Select fixed_territory two rounds before holdouts; matched round-one masks/no-offers and an initial-MOSAIC-frozen coordinator distinguish causal exchange from nominal revision. Fixed has 28 causal joint cases and six causal Apply cases; shared reciprocal_2 has six and two.

questions.query: Does an early UNSAT or exhausted SWARM-004 record without a closure ledger have zero required foreign obligations?
facts: No final closure ledger means closure_evaluated=false and unknown obligations, exported as null. Retain refused cases in denominators; they cannot Apply.
